stem: Use the test results to determine what the coded symbol '%' means.

evidence: The five symbols have five different meanings: >, <, =, ≥ and ≤.
Only two meanings remain for %: > or ≥.
explanation: From the three known entries, % can only mean > or ≥. The result 5 % 5 is false rules out ≥, because equality is allowed in ≥. Therefore, % means > (greater than).
